create_sarif_artifact: create a SARIF Artifact dataclass instance with contents, location, and roles for static analysis results
build_sarif_artifact_location: build a SARIF Artifact with an ArtifactLocation specifying file path and URI
test_sarif_artifact_roles: test the SARIF Artifact dataclass with roles like analysisTarget, resultFile, and attachment
summarize_sarif_artifact: summarize the SARIF Artifact dataclass fields including encoding, hashes, mime_type, and last_modified_time_utc
review_sarif_artifact: review the SARIF Artifact dataclass schema and its nested ArtifactContent, Message, and PropertyBag types
